title: Connect your coding agent from the front door
summary: The site now leads with the agent connection: a copyable npx @xnetjs/cli connect command with per-client tabs in the hero, a new /agents page covering installs, the three access lanes, and the safety model, and agent-readable entry points at /llms.txt and /agents.md. Zero-install connects now register an MCP server that keeps working after the npx cache is gone.
